'''Norman Horn'''<ref name="dt-16879">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16879 Pods and Odds - Norm's Tatooine Hunt Down], DeckTech (Norman "Norman" Horn, 20 June 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16879/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16879/ GitHub Pages].</ref> posted a [[Dark]] [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down]] list on DeckTech in June 2001.
